evidence.observation: Tube pressure has drifted monotonically from ~3.02 to 3.48 Torr since growth onset (k=21-26), far outside the flat ~3.0 Torr held through ramp
Ar flow steady at ~100 sccm, so the pressure rise is not a flow change
Thermocouple at setpoint 750 °C with stable heater power ~45%, so temperature control is nominal
Sensor not installed; growth-stage atmosphere (air ingress) cannot be verified

args.missing_evidence: An exhaust O2 reading (not installed) to distinguish air ingress from restriction; alternatively an Ar flow step test — pressure scaling with flow indicates exhaust blockage, a flow-independent offset indicates a seal leak.
